en: Vintage sepia postcard view of a small town with ornate villas and church spires at the foot of a forested mountain. In the foreground is a landscaped park with paths, lawns, and trees. The printed caption at the top reads "Bad Harzburg. Villen am Burgberge." and a vertical imprint on the left margin shows the publisher's name. The overall style suggests an early 20th‑century German spa resort scene.
